question: What does Chanda Mama try to count in the sky? ✨
explanation: Super! Chanda Mama tries to count the beautiful, twinkling stars in the night sky! ⭐

question: Who is Chanda Mama? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! We lovingly call the Moon our Chanda Mama! 🌙

question: When do we see Chanda Mama? 🌃
explanation: Great job! Chanda Mama comes out to shine when it gets dark at night. 🌌

question: Where does Chanda Mama live? 🌌
explanation: Excellent! The Moon and stars live high up in the vast sky! ☁️
hint: You look up to see it.

question: What do the stars do? ✨
explanation: Super! Stars look so pretty when they twinkle and shine in the dark! ✨

question: Can we count all the stars? 🤔
explanation: Awesome! There are so many stars in the sky that we cannot count them all! 🌟

question: What color is the night sky? 🌌
explanation: Great job! The sky turns dark blue or black when night falls. 🌌
hint: It is a very dark color.

question: What do we do at night? 🛏️
explanation: Super! Nighttime is the perfect time to rest and go to sleep. 😴
hint: You close your eyes in bed.

question: What does Chanda Mama give us? 🌕
explanation: Awesome! The Moon gives us a very beautiful and soft white light at night. 🌕
hint: It helps us see a little in the dark.

question: How does Chanda Mama move? 🚶
explanation: Great job! The Moon seems to glide and move very slowly across the sky. ☁️

question: What do the stars look like? 💎
explanation: Super! Far away in the sky, stars look like sparkling tiny diamonds! 💎

question: What hides Chanda Mama sometimes? ☁️
explanation: Awesome! Sometimes fluffy dark clouds cover the moon like a blanket. ☁️

question: Who tells us bedtime stories? 👵
explanation: Great job! Grandparents love telling us magical stories before we sleep! 📖
hint: People who love you at home.

question: What do we say before sleeping? 🌛
explanation: Super! We always wish our family a sweet 'Good night' before bed! 🌛

question: What shape is a full moon? 🌕
explanation: Awesome! A full moon looks like a perfect, glowing big circle! 🌕

question: What do we see when we sleep? 💭
explanation: Great job! When we sleep peacefully, we see lovely sweet dreams! 💭
hint: Stories in our mind at night.

question: Who loves to watch Chanda Mama? 👦👧
explanation: Super! Children love to look up and smile at Chanda Mama! 👦👧

question: Where do stars go in the morning? 🌅
explanation: Awesome! When the bright Sun comes out, the stars hide away! 🌅

question: How does Chanda Mama feel? 😊
explanation: Great job! Chanda Mama looks very peaceful, happy, and calm in the sky. 😊

question: Is Chanda Mama near or far? 🔭
explanation: Super! The moon is actually very, very far away from us! 🚀
hint: It takes a rocket to reach it.

question: What do stars play in the sky? 🙈
explanation: Awesome! Stars twinkle on and off like they are playing hide and seek! 🙈

question: What makes the night sky beautiful? 🌌
explanation: Great job! The glowing Moon and twinkling stars make the night very beautiful! 🌙

question: Where do you sleep? 🛏️
explanation: Super! We sleep comfortably in a warm, cozy bed at night. 🛏️

question: Who watches us while we sleep? 🌝
explanation: Awesome! Chanda Mama shines through the window to watch over us. 🌝

question: What bird stays awake at night? 🦉
explanation: Great job! Owls have big eyes and they love to stay awake at night! 🦉

question: What do you do when you see Chanda Mama? 😃
explanation: Super! Looking at the beautiful Moon makes us want to smile! 😃

question: What does Chanda Mama ride on? ☁️
explanation: Awesome! It looks like Chanda Mama is floating and riding on the soft clouds! ☁️
hint: Fluffy white things in the sky.

question: What happens when the Sun comes? ☀️
explanation: Great job! When the bright Sun wakes up, a beautiful morning starts! ☀️

question: What is next to Chanda Mama? ⭐
explanation: Super! Little stars are spread all around Chanda Mama in the sky! ⭐

question: How do you feel looking at the stars? 🥰
explanation: Awesome! Looking at so many stars makes us happy and full of wonder! ✨

question: What covers your bed at night? 🛌
explanation: Great job! A warm blanket keeps you cozy while you sleep under the stars. 🛌

question: What do children point at in the sky? ☝️
explanation: Super! We love to point up and say 'Look, there is Chanda Mama!' ☝️

question: What makes Chanda Mama smile? 😊
explanation: Awesome! Chanda Mama loves it when happy children look up at him. 😊

question: Where do we look to see the stars? 🔭
explanation: Great job! We have to look high up in the sky to spot the twinkling stars! 🌌

question: What brings the stars out? 🌌
explanation: Super! When the sky gets dark at night, the stars can finally shine! ✨

question: How big is the sky? ☁️
explanation: Awesome! The sky is incredibly big and has room for millions of stars! 🌌

question: What does a half moon look like? 🌙
explanation: Great job! A half moon (crescent) looks like a beautiful, bright smile! 😊

question: Who is our sky uncle? 👨
explanation: Super! 'Mama' means uncle, so Chanda Mama is our loving sky uncle! 🌙

question: What do stars form in the sky? 🌠
explanation: Awesome! Stars join together to make beautiful shapes and patterns! 🌠

question: What chases the stars away? ☀️
explanation: Great job! When the Sun brings morning light, the stars fade away! ☀️

question: How does the Moon feel? ❄️
explanation: Super! Unlike the hot Sun, the Moon gives us nice, cool light! 🌕

question: What is Chanda Mama's fun job? ⭐
explanation: Awesome! Chanda Mama stays up trying to count all his little star friends! ⭐

question: What do you wear to bed? 👚
explanation: Great job! We wear soft and comfy night clothes to sleep well! 🛌

question: What happens when it rains at night? 🌧️
explanation: Super! Rain clouds are thick, so they hide the stars from our view! 🌧️

question: What do we close when we sleep? 😴
explanation: Awesome! We close our eyes tight to rest and visit dreamland! 💤

question: Who shines the brightest at night? 🌕
explanation: Great job! The Moon is the biggest and brightest light in the night sky! 🌕

question: What do we hear at bedtime? 🎶
explanation: Super! Mothers sing gentle lullabies to help us fall asleep happily! 🎶

question: What rests at night? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! At night, the birds, animals, and trees all take a quiet rest. 🌳

question: How many stars are in the sky? ✨
explanation: Great job! The sky is filled with thousands and millions of shining stars! ✨

question: What makes Chanda Mama magical? ✨
explanation: Super! The beautiful glowing light makes Chanda Mama look very magical! ✨
hint: How he shines in the dark.
